== English errata comparison sources ==
Decipher broadened the piloting bonus from starships to anything Lando pilots and rephrased the Falcon condition. The bonuses, Cloud City control clause and Sabacc modifiers match. The January 2013 slip shows power 1. The original card, June 2017 slip and full D-E1 face show power 2. Decipher’s November 1998 entry replaces the game text. Players Committee, Decipher Errata, official text as of January 2013, PDF page 19, Light Side Lando Calrissian. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf#page=19 Internet Archive]. Players Committee, [[Media:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=18|Decipher Errata]], June 2017, PDF page 18, Light Side Lando Calrissian.

Decipher, [[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf#page=81|Glossary Version 2.0]], November 1998, PDF page 81. Players Committee, [[Media:SWCCG 2023 AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=119|2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, PDF page 119. [[:File:CC-L-landocalrissian.gif|Complete D-E1 face]].
